name: cs_ComputeLightLUT
description: Light LUT compute (ContextImp_D3D11::RenderVolume_DoVolume_Spotlight 0x18000A8D0 / _Omni 0x18000B700). bit0 LIGHTMODE: field 0 -> LIGHTMODE_OMNI (point LUT only: omni lights and spotlights with FalloffMode NONE), field 1 -> LIGHTMODE_SPOTLIGHT (point + S1/S2 LUTs, FalloffMode FIXED); bits1-2 = eAttenuationMode; bit3 COMPUTEPASS (0: Dispatch(8,64,1) per-sample inscatter + 32-wide prefix sum, 1: Dispatch(1,128,1|3) carry row sums)
